Fixed src/lib/g0Variants.ts's countTeenFrame handler (the tenFrame(...) call previously at line ~422-425) to keep preFilled=0 (the only value the widget can honestly render) and rewrite the prompt to state the ten-and-more decomposition as a math fact about the teen number rather than a claim about the widget's rendered state, then ask only for the achievable extra-dots target -- mirroring the already-correct shapeSortFrame handler's honest pattern. This matches A4's (s327-A4-knb-01-03) independently-reached diagnosis and recommended fix direction exactly. Sibling sweep (S328 step 5), same basis as knb-01-04.
